$Comment: Records' Dungeons tab. The plain stat ids are the columns of its first choice, All dungeons: every dungeon run a player began, cleared and failed, over every dungeon. Each Stat/* entry is one column of a single dungeon picked from the list, read over its own runs (a dungeon's line is dungeon:<difficulty>@<dungeon id>, dungeon:@My_Crypt for a normal run); a dungeon run at more than one difficulty also shows each difficulty on its own. At most four of each. The game's own portal dungeons count here too once a PortalDungeons file follows them, as the Deepworks does. A stat nothing on this server counts shows no column. Icon pictures the tab; HintKey is the line a player with no place on the board reads.
